package.name: parol6_control_services
package.description: ROS 2 service wrappers for one-off imperative PAROL6 operations that don't fit ros2_control's continuous read/write loop: std_srvs/Trigger services (home, gripper open/close), plus call_method_node's generic parol6_interfaces/CallMethod pass-through to any RobotClient method. Connects a parol6 RobotClient directly to parol6-server, independent of the ros2_control/parol6_bridge path.
